description: This file defines functions related to platform upgrade procedures for a specific hardware platform, including a basic image check and a default upgrade method based on board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the platform-specific upgrade; defaults to 'default_do_upgrade' if no specific board is matched.
